python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
pages = [Path('docs/philosophy.md'), Path('docs/README.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md'), *Path('docs/adrs').glob('000*.md')]
count = 0
for page in pages:
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        destination = page.parent / name if name else page
        assert destination.is_file(), f'{page}: missing {target}'
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', destination.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w\s-]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs, f'{page}: missing anchor {target}'
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} local documentation links and their anchors.')
